Name: LFM Matching Drinks Retexture
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=3][center][i][color=#fff2cc][b]A little addition meant to be used with [/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10035]Lux's Sprite Mod[/url] (check it out, it's gorgeous!)[/b][/color][/i][/center]
[b]This mod replaces 5 drinks textures listed below:[/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Coffee[/size]
[*][size=3]Green Tea[/size]
[*][size=3]Joja Cola[/size]
[*][size=3]Energy Tonic[/size]
[*][size=3]Muscle Remedy﻿[/size]
[/list]
You can choose between different versions of Joja Cola and Energy Tonic in mod's config.

This mod is 1.6 update for my two older mods -[b] [/b][b]LFM matching Joja Cola and Energy Tonic replacer[/b] and [b]LFM Matching Coffee and tea Replacer.

[/b][b]Installation:[/b]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url],  and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] [/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3130]Scale Up 2[/url]﻿[/size]

[*][size=3]Run game using SMAPI[/size]
[/list][/size]

Manifest.Name: LFM Matching Drinks Retexture
Manifest.Description: Replaces a few vanilla drinks textures to match Lux's Sprite Mod.
